decisions.capability: Check workflow/secret controls and selected dependency identity
decisions.evidence_scope: Native gitleaks and zizmor accepted clean controls and rejected inert unsafe fixtures; Syft matched thirty-six selected SDK distributions.
limitations: Secret scanning is not proof of no secret anywhere; regular offline workflow analysis is scoped.
The financial SDK fixture supports dependency enumeration only, not financial behavior or vulnerability assurance.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify new distributions or security boundaries independently.

decisions.capability: Detect and handle secrets/credentials through native sign-in and inventory scans
decisions.evidence_scope: Reuses the existing gitleaks inventory and acceptance evidence; no new execution was run to freeze this taxonomy layer.
limitations: openbao remains an unused, unqualified candidate; broker credential handling is a trading gate, not a foundation selection.
Native login state and account credentials are not inventoried as a component in this catalog.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify openbao only against a concrete secret-management gap that native login and gitleaks do not already cover.

existing_overturn_when: A concrete multi-host or multi-operator secret-sharing need appears, and openbao (or a comparable secret manager) passes an actual installed/queried comparison against the native-login-only policy.
limitations: Broker credential handling is a trading gate, not a foundation selection.
Native login state itself is not inventoried as a component in this catalog.
requirement: Keep sign-ins and credentials off the checkout and detect accidental secret exposure before publication.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
